title: legal_hold.propagation_registered payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `legal_hold.propagation_registered`. `state` is published explicitly, including unknown and failed, so an unresolved propagation is visible rather than silently absent. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
